news.title: SAR Televenture Limited (NSEI:SARTELE) entered share purchase agreement to acquire 70.17% stake in Grand Foundry Limited (BSE:513343) from Gaurav Goyal and Rakesh Kumar Bsnsal for INR 32 million.
news.body: SAR Televenture Limited (NSEI:SARTELE) entered share purchase agreement to acquire 70.17% stake in Grand Foundry Limited (BSE:513343) from Gaurav Goyal and Rakesh Kumar Bsnsal for INR 32 million on March 3, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 32.03 million will be paid by SAR Televenture Limited. As part of consideration, INR 32.03 million is paid towards common equity of Grand Foundry Limited. Board of SAR Televenture Limited approved the transaction. In a related transaction, acquisition of up to 79,11,800 equity shares at INR 2.50 per share, representing 26% of the total stake of Grand Foundry Limited, from its public shareholders through open offer. The transaction will be completed within six months.

news.title: Grand Foundry Limited Announces Resignation of Nalini Singh as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective January 8, 2026
news.body: Grand Foundry Limited announced that Ms. Nalini Singh has tendered her resignation from the post of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer (Key Managerial Personnel) due to personal reasons. The resignation is effective from the close of business hours on January 8, 2026. Ms. Nalini Singh requested acknowledgment of her resignation letter and arrangement to file the necessary forms with the Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, and intimation to the stock exchanges to give effect to this resignation.

news.title: Grand Foundry Limited Announces CFO Changes, Effective from January 5, 2025
news.body: Grand Foundry Limited announced that the Board of Directors of the Company in Meeting held on 5th January, 2026 have considered and approved the resignations of Ms. Shivani Jain from the post of CFO due to her pre-occupation elsewhere and announced the appointment of Mr. Nitin Gupta as Chief Financial Officer. Nitin Gupta is a finance and accounts professional with over 14 years of extensive experience in Accounts, Finance, Taxation (Direct & Indirect), and Auditing. He holds a B.Com degree and has completed CA Inter. Currently, he has been working with Harso Steels Private Limited for the past 9 years, contributing strong expertise in financial management, compliance, and taxation. The effective date is January 5, 2025.
